items.difficulty_reason: 13 行、Ext 对 I^nM 像的 Artin-Rees 控制：K 伪凝聚，取有限自由 A-模的上方有界代表 F，Ext^p(K,M) 是三项 Hom 复形的上同调；Ext^p(K,I^nM) 由同一复形把 M 换成 I^nM 计算；由 consequence-Artin-Rees-bis 引理，各次 Hom(F^q, I^nM) -> Hom(F^q, M) 的像一致地含于 I^{n-c}·Hom(F^q,M)（n≥c），取上同调保持包含即得结论。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-ext-induced-toplogy (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 29583-29590

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the representation of Ext_A^p(K, M) as the cohomology of a three-term Hom complex out of the finite free resolution of K, the computation of Ext_A^p(K, I^n M) by the same complex with M replaced by I^n M, and the termwise application of the Artin-Rees consequence lemma to control the images by I^{n-c} (source lines 29592-29604)
